artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the bread crust appears slightly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine irregularities of real baked dough. The flour dusting looks somewhat uniform and sprayed-on rather than naturally settled.
The edges of the chocolate cake layers appear slightly soft and ill-defined, with the frosting piping lacking sharp structural integrity, suggesting minor geometric melting.
The horizontal lines of the display case shelves show slight warping and inconsistency in parallelism, particularly towards the right edge.

To assess the realism of textures (bread crust, frosting) and identify subtle AI-generation artifacts like smoothing or noise patterns.
To check for spatial consistency between the shelves, glass panels, and baked goods, ensuring no floating objects or depth bleeding.
To ensure the bread loaves are distinct, continuous objects without merging into the boards or background.

focus_areas: Texture realism of bread crust and flour dusting

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the bread; AI often generates 'smooth' bread that lacks pore structure. Check if the flour looks like natural dusting or a digital overlay. Verify the geometry of the cake layers—are they straight and rigid? Look for any 'melting' where the pastries touch the wooden boards.
